command:
set -euo pipefail
COMPOSE=deploy/compose/docker-compose.test.yml
DB=riccon_v8_check
ROOT_PW="${RICCON_DB_ROOT_PASSWORD:-riccon_root_test_only}"
USER_PW="${RICCON_DB_PASSWORD:-riccon_test_only}"
docker compose -f "$COMPOSE" exec -T -e MYSQL_PWD="$ROOT_PW" mysql mysql --user=root --batch -e "DROP DATABASE IF EXISTS $DB; CREATE DATABASE $DB CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci; GRANT ALL PRIVILEGES ON $DB.* TO 'riccon'@'%'; FLUSH PRIVILEGES;"
for f in apps/api/src/main/resources/db/migration/V*.sql; do
  echo "== $f"
  docker compose -f "$COMPOSE" exec -T -e MYSQL_PWD="$USER_PW" mysql mysql --user=riccon --database="$DB" --batch --show-warnings < "$f"
done
COLUMNS=$(docker compose -f "$COMPOSE" exec -T -e MYSQL_PWD="$USER_PW" mysql mysql --user=riccon --database="$DB" --batch --skip-column-names -e "SELECT COUNT(*) FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_schema='$DB' AND table_name='approval' AND column_name IN ('params_ciphertext','params_key_id');")
CHECKS=$(docker compose -f "$COMPOSE" exec -T -e MYSQL_PWD="$USER_PW" mysql mysql --user=riccon --database="$DB" --batch --skip-column-names -e "SELECT COUNT(*) FROM information_schema.check_constraints WHERE constraint_schema='$DB' AND constraint_name LIKE 'chk_approval_params%';")
test "$COLUMNS" = "2"
test "$CHECKS" = "6"
docker compose -f "$COMPOSE" exec -T -e MYSQL_PWD="$ROOT_PW" mysql mysql --user=root --batch -e "DROP DATABASE $DB;"
echo "V1-V8 applied on fresh database: columns=$COLUMNS checks=$CHECKS"
note: 测试栈 MySQL 8.4.13 全新库按 V1–V8 应用；断言 V8 密文列、key id 与 6 条 CHECK 约束存在
